title: Exact-base change apply permit materializer
goal: Materialize an admitted exact-base MISSION_CHANGE_APPLY_REQUEST as a one-shot apply permit without mutating canonical files.
laws: Permit requires VERIFIED_CHANGE_CANDIDATE evidence and exact current target SHA match.
Patch SHA-256 must equal the candidate patchDigest.
Patch changed paths must exactly equal the verified candidate changedFiles.
Trust Canal DECK-APPLY admission must bind candidateId, missionId, patchDigest and targetSha.
Permit is one-shot and status APPLY_READY_NOT_STARTED.
No git apply, file write, commit, builder, or worker launch occurs in this mission.
Stale or malformed evidence fails closed.
